rites.name: Serontes
rites.text: Serontes is the concept of Shizasha's first sounding, the note by which the world's roots gathered into shape during the Singing, long before any calendar recorded it. In the Age of the first sovereign it is remembered as the force that taught groves to bind together into growing kingdoms.

rites.name: Valeolinia
rites.text: Valeolinia is the concept of a resonant tone that gathers loose matter into the first roots of Shizasha during the Singing, before any dated record begins. In the Age of Strangers it was the bond that outside travelers anchored themselves to when they came to trade. Its voice is said to settle wherever a bargain is struck.

rites.name: Merakaira
rites.text: Merakaira is a concept of Shizasha, the thought that a single trial may be passed only by the one who first lets go of the Courts' seat. Its judges weigh each claim against the Stellar order, and its councils are said to have set the first doors between worlds.

rites.name: Coraullium
rites.text: Fighters of this craft strike only at foes standing directly beside them. Their attacks reach no farther than an arm's length, so distance itself becomes their shield.

rites.name: Sollia
rites.text: A quiet force that one caster projects to smother another's mind. Lesser shrines can strengthen it, and the victim can hold it back with a power of her own.

rites.name: Coreostes
rites.text: A close-combat striking method used by swarm creatures that fight on the ground. It is learned at a breeding hollow and can be sharpened through a process of gradual change to hit harder.

rites.name: Ceostontus
rites.text: A ritual hymn sung by a towering beast-chieftain, recorded upon a night-song collection of ancient battle-verses. It rouses the listeners to martial fervor.

rites.name: Theisora
rites.text: Theisora is the concept of the Weave, the lattice of quiet power that the makers plant across Shizasha during the Seeding. In the Holy Age its devotees keep the flames of the temples burning and hold the powers asleep in their orders.

rites.name: Liarinium
rites.text: Liarinium is a concept of Shizasha, the substance the makers believe lets the Weave hold its shape during the Seeding, when quiet powers are put to sleep. In the Holy Age, temple orders bind it into ritual lamps and wards that flare when a sworn oath is broken.

rites.name: Vaulanum
rites.text: Psionic warriors who channel mental power to aid their fellow fighters in battle. They lend strength to the wider forces that stand beside them.

rites.name: Valauleonor
rites.text: A mind-born craft wielded by elite armored soldiers who draw dim unseen force from the emptiness around them. It briefly stuns every foe nearby, and when paired with a rushing dash it lets them break through dense ranks of enemies.

rites.name: Orerum
rites.text: A ball of crackling charged force is hurled along a straight line, injuring everything it strikes along the way. Near a surge of vital current, the bearer can loose three of them at once.

rites.name: Krukaiggoth
rites.text: Krukaiggoth is the concept of the Pact that was sworn among the broken worlds of Shizasha after the Sundering, binding the drifting Shards into a shared covenant. It names the oath that the first sovereign and the growing groves kept as the Fall ended and new kingdoms took root.

rites.name: Serianausor
rites.text: A grey haze clouds any ground where no ally stands, hiding present movements while leaving the last seen state of terrain and structures visible. Watchers may send a scout inside or sweep the area with a pulse to lift the veil.

rites.name: Siallium
rites.text: A tap of a chosen sign or small cluster of signs triggers a set action at once. It lets a leader send instructions swiftly, gaining sharper control and saving precious moments.

rites.name: Lerisus
rites.text: A deceptive illusion conjured by a sensitive mind, producing false copies of a figure that misdirect foes. Hostile forces waste their strikes on these phantoms during a clash.

rites.name: Sallauntia
rites.text: A learned mental craft that seizes the flowing energy inside a foe and turns it back upon them. Living bodies suffer deep wounds, and machines can be torn apart when their own power rebounds through them.

rites.name: Viallanum
rites.text: A tactic in which small raiding forces strike at an opponent's supply routes and gatherers to delay their advancement, army buildup, and resource income. It lets the raider grow stronger while the rival is kept from striking back in full force.

rites.name: Reontes
rites.text: A standing order that sends a guard along a looping route between chosen marks on the land. The guard strikes any foe that crosses its path, then returns to its first post once the threat is gone.

rites.name: Valinia
rites.text: A melodic composition performed by a high-ranked warrior of the plains folk. It appears as one of the pieces on that warrior's recorded collection.

rites.name: Rostirnum
rites.text: A swift raid tactic that slips through a gap in an outer guard to strike a stronghold from behind, ignoring slow defenders. Sealing the entrances stops it, and it can also harass the workers who feed the enemy.

rites.name: Mianteosus
rites.text: A mind-born knack that lets a seer perceive what lies behind barriers and beyond corners. Some restless spirits are said to carry this gift.

rites.name: Nintia Amosalum
rites.text: A patient, low-crouched style of blade fighting taught by a single wandering duelist. It is practiced by people who favor silent approach over open clash.

rites.name: Neolliantum
rites.text: A mental gift that lets a person shift and press upon solid things with thought alone. Practitioners can turn the mind itself into a striking force.

rites.name: Montium
rites.text: A practitioner releases a sphere of mind-born energy that flings crackling sparks at everything it passes. It travels in one straight line until its glow fades away.

rites.name: Sontirnia
rites.text: A basic inner power that lets a mind perceive the thoughts of others without speech. It is found among many different peoples and creatures.

rites.name: Nosanum
rites.text: A trained adept of the sealed lineage releases a lance of inner force against a foe. Repeated bursts can be hurled from a short distance in quick succession, wounding heavily.

rites.name: Ilyameina
rites.text: Ilyameina is the concept of holding walls in Shizasha, an idea that took shape over centuries of the Walled Age as orders and churches learned to keep the wild outside. Its earliest recorded use was the first crossing made through a gate that no one had yet been allowed to pass.

rites.name: Xaesyustith
rites.text: Xaesyustith is the concept of walls held against the dark between stars, first set down in the Walled Age when the orders raised their first bulwarks. It is remembered as the patience that keeps a boundary standing across centuries, and the first crossings were judged by how faithfully it was kept.

rites.name: Goukak
rites.text: Goukak is the concept of the Walled Age in Shizasha, the long span in which great walls were raised, orders and churches took their shape, and the first crossings between holding and wilderness were made. It is less a force than an idea that binds the age's stone and oaths together. It persists wherever a people decides a line is worth defending.

rites.name: Varniasanum
rites.text: A mind-born power in which a wielder releases a heavy burst of inner force at a foe. It flows as a continuous stream rather than a single shot, and can be intensified by a rage-fueled gift.

rites.name: Cerus
rites.text: A standard strike technique used by winged swarm creatures from the air. Its power can be strengthened over time through evolutionary development.

rites.name: Neorum
rites.text: A tailored energy that a lone engineer channels through a orbiting web of relay spheres, which can be tuned to hasten movement, mend nearby allies, or refill their power reserves.

rites.name: Sinesor
rites.text: A disruptive surge technique that overloads the energy barriers of a rival people's shielding. It takes several forms, including handheld charges, field weapons, and vessel-borne bursts.

rites.name: Cornantium
rites.text: A sensing power that uncovers hidden foes and illusions. Every people fields a mobile sensor, while fixed watchtowers hold the same sight in sturdier form.

rites.name: Caurum
rites.text: A faint mind-reading gift lets a person sense the feelings of others, with each feeling felt in a way that matches its kind. Some use it to read rivals before a fight.

rites.name: Corillanum Torastus
rites.text: A hidden art that lets its users slip out of sight, reached either through engineered devices or through the focused power of the mind. Both paths of this craft make a bearer invisible to watchers.

rites.name: Veostiales
rites.text: A practitioner raises a barrier of mind-born energy that halts all passage through it. Stronger forms let trusted companions cross while keeping foes out.

rites.name: Serilum
rites.text: A combat discipline devised by the surviving staff of a broken alliance inside a research complex. It is taught as a method of armed fighting.

rites.name: Orantolus
rites.text: A mind-born power that seizes a group of foes and holds them suspended in the air, dealing steady harm. The wielder can scale its force, sometimes lifting a single foe by the throat without inflicting lasting injury.

rites.name: Viantes
rites.text: A mind-born technique that lets a wielder leap a short distance in a burst of crackling force. The flash of energy strikes and stuns every foe gathered around the wielder.

rites.name: Ameollestia
rites.text: A tactic where a handful of casters are grouped tightly so they move as one block and cast in unison, aimed just beyond a second grouping so their effects do not bunch together. Flying fighters are kept loosely spread to blunt area-of-effect blasts.

rites.name: Nallanum
rites.text: A tactic in which a squad of armored gunners is paired with several healers who mend wounds and sustain battle drugs. The gunners hold the field longer, while the healers cannot restore themselves but can restore one another.

rites.name: Oriasaunus
rites.text: A mind-born power releases a ring of silent force from its wielder, lifting and harming nearby foes and briefly freezing them in place. It is weaker against massive beasts, which it can only slow.

rites.name: Amianallor
rites.text: A mental craft that lets a reborn hive-born warrior reshape living essence, restoring her own flesh and that of nearby kin. A wild primal guardian can wield the same gift to heal himself and his companions.

rites.name: Mauniaranum
rites.text: A projected likeness of its bearer that looks convincing and can strike foes, yet has no solid body. Such shades serve well as extra numbers on a field but cannot replace a full force.

rites.name: Serentus Orernes
rites.text: A mind-born craft that lets a user hurl a focused pulse of inner force at one foe, delivering crushing harm to that single target.

rites.name: Seresanum
rites.text: A deadly contagion carried by tiny burrowing vermin on a distant world. It kills outsiders from far shores, yet a careful dose can grant lasting resistance to it.

rites.name: Tentaunium
rites.text: A procedure that erases a person's recollections, sometimes across a chosen stretch of time. Agents of a secret service undergo it to keep them obedient and their missions hidden.

rites.name: Teosauntum
rites.text: A mind-born power that lets a reborn warrior surge through a crowd of foes like a rushing wind. Everyone she passes through suffers harm from the rush.

rites.name: Reosium
rites.text: A tactical order that lets carriers without weapons travel to a marked point or trail a chosen companion. Units under this order keep moving and do not stop to fight anyone they pass.

rites.name: Amialostium
rites.text: A mutation pathway that lets a hardy swarm creature reshape into a tougher form. It is pursued as a directed task within a larger campaign of conquest.

rites.name: Valestonor
rites.text: A channeled inner force that floods the body and sharpens its quickness and reaction. Some fighters can push this flow far enough to briefly dissolve into raw light while charging foes.

rites.name: Siallus Serallus
rites.text: A tune performed by a high-ranking war chieftain of the wandering horned folk. It appears on one of the recordings from their Stormlight Ember collection.

rites.name: Nornum
rites.text: A mental faculty that lets a mind perceive hidden inner forces around it. It arises naturally in one hive-minded brood and can also be trained in gifted outsiders.

rites.name: Corontallum
rites.text: A targeting technique where a single caster answers a shared command meant for a whole group, so only one spell is cast and the rest of the stored energy is kept from being wasted.

rites.name: Rausor
rites.text: A mind-craft in which a gifted caster pours inner force into the glowing barriers of allied warriors, restoring them. Practitioners learned to draw on storm-like inner power to shield their comrades in desperate battles.

rites.name: Veollostium
rites.text: A mind-born craft in which a wielder shapes a glowing sphere of living energy and hurls it at a foe. The impact deals heavy harm, often ending a lesser opponent instantly.

rites.name: Vaurnia
rites.text: A mind-born craft lets a practitioner take vitality from a living foe who has fallen. The victor is restored in strength and in protective wards.

rites.name: Teleonarnia
rites.text: A tempest of raw mind-force is unleashed by a gifted thinker. Elite arcane warriors and a sovereign ruler wield this devastating technique.

rites.name: Ameranum Virnosus
rites.text: A mind-born power that a once-corrupted woman can call upon after being freed of a hive's grip. It sends a faint, harmful wave through every foe within its reach.

rites.name: Neontia
rites.text: A mental sense that lets a practitioner perceive distant scenes without using the body's ordinary eyes. Certain restless spirits are said to share this gift.

rites.name: Orarnesus
rites.text: A mind-woven barrier that a caster raises from pure thought to guard their body against injury. One known practitioner wields this inner ward.

rites.name: Neornausium
rites.text: A mental gift that lets a seer glimpse coming events and sense the shape of what is yet to unfold. It is sometimes regarded as a kind of foretelling.

rites.name: Sastillor
rites.text: Two allied peoples pool their strengths, where one side's healers keep swarming warriors alive and a combined strike weakens a rival's outpost. Shields are drained first, then a disease wears down the foe until they are easy prey.

rites.name: Tosiales
rites.text: A mind-born art that closes wounds and restores clarity after a stunning blow. One who can wield it may use the focus of thought to mend hurt and steady a dazed body.

rites.name: Vernaunum
rites.text: A mental gift lets a seer read the history of a person by holding one of their belongings. The seer perceives the lingering impressions of that owner's past thoughts.

rites.name: Liarnes
rites.text: A shimmering barrier woven from mind-energy and engineered lattices guards its wielders from harm. Its machinery, however, falls silent when a pulse of disruptive charge sweeps across it.

rites.name: Rantanum Nentolia
rites.text: A mind-born art that lets beings bend the unseen world through will alone. Its strength fades quickly with distance, and a single altered trait in a body can silence it entirely.

rites.name: Meostus
rites.text: A mind-born force that a trained user focuses into one foe, unleashing their full inner power to slay most targets. Mastery demands grueling discipline, and those who bear resentment toward their commanders are judged unfit to wield it.

rites.name: Valernus
rites.text: A mental craft that lets a former host of a hive-like swarm strike at enemies with a dark, unseen force drawn from her human heritage. It wounds those who stand against her.

rites.name: Mausor Nolenus
rites.text: A grown-up caller can temporarily taint a nest structure so it lashes out at nearby foes with a cloud of glowing swarm-fliers. The effect covers a broad square, making it stronger when several nests stand close together.

rites.name: Corinia
rites.text: A contest of colored gems where matching clusters charges energy for summoning fighters and casting spells. Rival sides send their forces against each other across up to five rounds.

rites.name: Seriastanum
rites.text: A held stillness that suspends living bodies in a frozen sleep. Two peoples of the age each keep their own version of this quiet suspension.

rites.name: Vausum
rites.text: A mind-craft in which a practitioner releases a brief, sharp pulse of inner force that harms a foe standing close by. Adepts of the highest rank are said to wield it.

rites.name: Tauntillia
rites.text: A mind-force is projected outward from the body and strikes another living being, briefly switching off its thinking without lasting harm. Certain gifted users can do this, and some monstrous hybrid breeds do it with greater lethality.

rites.name: Sereles
rites.text: A mind-born craft lets a caster split off three identical duplicates of themselves. The duplicates match the caster's vitality and guards and strike just as hard, but they all fade away the moment the caster falls.

rites.name: Seolia
rites.text: A mind-driven power that lets a wielder turn fury and resolve into a focused blast. The blast tears apart living flesh and hurls heat through it, though armored foes still give way before it.

rites.name: Teleolentes
rites.text: A telekinetic strike born of mental energy, where a gifted user assaults the mind of a rival directly. Only a handful of humans are known to wield it.

rites.name: Colium
rites.text: A force that strikes a target and also harms everything nearby, with the strongest effect at the center and weaker effects farther out. It works best against crowds of fragile foes and can sometimes injure allies standing close by, while even hidden creatures are not safe from it.

rites.name: Meosia
rites.text: A concealed snare woven by seers that freezes anything crossing its invisible threshold in place. It is set and sustained by a single attuned caster.

rites.name: Sheisora
rites.text: Sheisora is a drifting measure of the Stellar realm's seventh age, a knot of recollection that gathers around a single remembered dawn and then unravels. When it tightens, the surrounding lightfall bends and the past briefly reappears in the present sky.

rites.name: Osiazisora
rites.text: Osiazisora is a stellar-scale concept warden of the sixth age, a luminous lattice that circles dying suns and stores their fading heat. When a system begins to collapse, it can rekindle a dim star by pouring its banked radiance back into the core, though it rarely does so without a sly wink at the cosmos.

rites.name: Xaessora
rites.text: Xaessora is a stellar-scale concept from the Shizasha omniverse, a luminous engine-body that drinks the fusion of dying suns during the seventh age of the Sixth Epoch. Its shell can endure the collapse of a star's core, though it is said to hunger for the companion stars that orbit it.

rites.name: Zephezith
rites.text: Zephezith is a drifting lattice of crystalline light that coils between dying suns in the Stellar realm of Shizasha. It feeds on the collapse of stars, storing their fading heat in sheets of luminous glass that it can unfold into vast mirrors.

rites.name: Vosus
rites.text: A mind-power lets its wielder drain the vital force of living things and transform it into psionic energy. The strength gained depends on how much life is near to be taken.

rites.name: Cellia
rites.text: A fleet-borne method of burning every living thing off a world's surface using colossal beams from hulking vessels. The bombardment strips away the air and splits the crust, leaving the ground changed.

rites.name: Valerium
rites.text: A mind-born flame of hatred that a jailer in a void realm hurls at intruders. It lashes out at those who come to challenge him and his prisoner.

rites.name: Nilium
rites.text: A transcendent mind-power that lets a being who has ascended beyond her former form empower those she commands. Her presence drives the forces around her to act with greater speed and ferocity.

rites.name: Meorniares
rites.text: A mental craft that lets a practitioner slip out of the physical world, rendering them untouchable and able to drift, though they cannot act upon anything while the slip lasts.

rites.name: Neosia Montiarium
rites.text: A mind-born craft that lets a risen ascendant and every ally gathered near her step instantly to another spot overgrown by living fungal carpet.

rites.name: Carneontes
rites.text: A craft of reshaping a living being's inner blueprint directly, practiced by several peoples and their ancient makers. One ancient line of artisans took up the art only sparingly.

rites.name: Naurnus
rites.text: A mind-born craft that releases a rolling tide of hollow, dark energy. It batters everything in its path and hurls the targets violently backward.

rites.name: Valarium
rites.text: A restorative craft that mends the flesh of living allies in the field. Some hive-born beings can also draw swift mending into their own bodies from the bodies of their kin.

rites.name: Vernianor
rites.text: A mind-bending craft where a shadowed sorcerer pours unstable void-force into foes, driving them into madness until they turn on their own allies.

rites.name: Ameoles
rites.text: A mind-born power that lets a gifted user collapse large machines of war, even vessels as big as battlecruisers, by crushing them inward. It is wielded during a great conflict between peoples.

rites.name: Viantillum
rites.text: A mind-craft that lifts a foe into the air and holds them there, unable to move. Only certain hybrid folk and a few crafters of the far future can wield it.

rites.name: Viares Raulor
rites.text: A mind-born technique in which a practitioner springs high into the air and drops onto a single foe, tearing through them. It is said to be wielded by a reborn hive-bred warrior during a long war between great powers.

rites.name: Ventollia
rites.text: A mind-born power that stirs a swarm of followers into a wild rage. It makes them deadlier and quicker as they strike.

rites.name: Lires
rites.text: A craft that lets many sky-bound strongholds rise from their footing and drift to fresh ground. Those under siege can flee so they are not wiped out, leaving foes that strike only earthbound targets unable to follow.

rites.name: Nintia
rites.text: A chrysalis is formed when a creature changes into a watching form. The shell marks the moment one kind of being becomes another that oversees its kind.

rites.name: Sares
rites.text: A psionic power that unleashes a surge of mental force, freezing a crowd of living beings across a broad area in place for a short time. Shadowy war-wielders of the mind call upon it in battle.

rites.name: Ciantor
rites.text: A psychic strike that stuns and wounds foes by slamming a shrieking pulse into their minds. Stronger versions can kill outright, and survivors become sensitive to the thoughts of nearby minds.

rites.name: Misanum
rites.text: A mental craft that stirs every nearby beast into attacking whichever target the caster chooses. The wild creatures turn on that chosen foe at once.

rites.name: Miastirium
rites.text: A mind-born force that a wayfarer calls upon at the brink of death, halting the end and mending torn flesh and failing barriers. It also erupts outward, hurling nearby foes backward and wounding them.

rites.name: Orerus Sialia
rites.text: A whirling current of dark force that certain blended wielders can summon. When three such currents join, they can drag an entire world into a sealed void.

rites.name: Veonor
rites.text: A mind-craft in which a practitioner draws vitality from a companion, weakening that companion while restoring the caster's own strength and protective barrier. It works like a sustained siphon rather than a sudden strike.

rites.name: Tallostanum
rites.text: A mind-born spark that a practitioner hurls as a crackling bolt, striking a distant foe. Adepts wield it as their long-reaching attack in shared battles.

rites.name: Mastium Serillia
rites.text: A mind-born craft lets a practitioner send a flawless double ahead, then slip across to join it after a brief pause. Scouts use it to probe hostile lines or bypass fortified defenses, and a resonance focus strengthens the working.

rites.name: Serollum
rites.text: A mental power that lets gifted minds join together into one shared current of thought. Each participant sends their own ideas on a chosen subject into the joined whole.

rites.name: Saunteles
rites.text: A mind-born power in which a wielder who has risen to a higher, cosmic form focuses a searing lance of raw energy onto a fixed structure. The beam tears through the target and inflicts devastating harm.

rites.name: Testaulus
rites.text: A mind-born art in which a wielder encloses a foe within a three-cornered cage of empty, unmade force. The captive slips out of existence, unable to strike and beyond the reach of any blow.

rites.name: Teorum
rites.text: A psionic tempest cast by a hive-mind leader that unleashes a wide cloud of energy, striking every foe caught within its area and dealing harm to them.

rites.name: Valliasia
rites.text: A caster hurls a vast burst of mind-born force at a chosen foe, dealing heavy harm to it. A stronger form of this rite is wielded by a radiant embodiment of shape.

rites.name: Valistum
rites.text: A mind can reach into certain engines and devices, hearing them like a voice and sensing their condition. Some people gain this link after heavy exposure to a strange substance.

rites.name: Amiarnanum Lirnanum
rites.text: A rare inner technique lets a single gifted user dim their mind so that hive minds ignore them as one of their own. Barriers of mental shielding or other sensing minds can break the effect.

rites.name: Miarnellia
rites.text: A orbital watch-eye is called down from high above to uncover a broad stretch of hidden ground. Anything cloaked or buried within that span is exposed to view.

rites.name: Amirases
rites.text: Practitioners hurl a sphere of hollow dark force that detonates on a foe after a brief delay. The victim is then dragged into sluggishness, leaving them exposed to follow-up strikes.

rites.name: Serillium Sorallium
rites.text: A mental gift that bends time so a practitioner briefly views the world through a rival's eyes. It also exposes hidden burrowers, unseen fighters, and concealed machines without any special instruments.
